rv.q: Going Bacharach: The Songs of an Icon is the world of music in our lives on the stage at The Marjorie S. Theater and it is a must see, must experience.
Directing the off-kilter caboodle is superb lyricist David Zippel, who on this (first?) directorial outing is less than superb.
Her shimmering interpretation of “Alfie” is a highlight.
So, hello, I may even be going back to “Going Bacharach” before this run ends.
Nevertheless, the concert showcased the impressive versatility of The New York Pops and its performers while celebrating the many voices that have shaped America’s musical identity.

cn.t: Critics praise this well-performed tribute to Burt Bacharach's timeless songwriting, celebrating his distinctive melodies and seven-decade legacy with exceptional musicianship and lovingly curated arrangements.
